## Summary
Implements `DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0007I` (NEXT-TRANCHE-001).

- Adds `TrustedInputCapability` (private mint token; non-serializable)
- Adds fail-closed `is_execution_eligible` (always False while adapters empty)
- `active_trusted_adapters() == []` — **no mutation adapter enabled**
- Focused tests + full `tests/unit/dcp` green

## Non-claims
- No runner/connector/MCP/Dopetask/TO/GitHub/live writes
- No trusted mutation adapter enabled
- `serialized_trust_supported: false`
- Does **not** rewrite `RouteDecision.is_runnable` (allowlist forbid); residual disclosed for 0007T/A

## Proof
`proof/DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0007I/`

## Test plan
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/dcp/test_input_adapters.py`
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/dcp`
- [x] `ruff check` on touched files
- [x] allowlist-only diff
